components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized by
            removing every non-digit character and must contain exactly 10 digits
            afterwards.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be
            a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered. Optional on create; when not
            supplied it defaults to the server's current date. Returned in ISO
            'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as "LastName, FirstName".
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'Franklin, George'
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'G.F.'
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:

## Summary

I changed telephone handling to store and compare numbers in E.164 form.

**`OwnerRestControllerV1.java`** — replaced the "strip non-digits, require exactly 10" logic with a `toE164(String)` helper that:
- strips spaces, dashes and brackets (`[\s\-()]`);
- keeps a leading `+` and country code when present; otherwise assumes `+61` and drops a single leading `0` from the national digits;
- requires 8–15 digits after the `+`, returning `null` (→ HTTP 400) when the number can't form valid E.164.

`addOwner` now stores the E.164 string as `telephone` and detects duplicates by comparing E.164 values (normalizing each existing owner's number the same way).

**`Owner.java`** — the entity validation constraint was the source of a 500 (it forced exactly 10 digits). Replaced `@Digits(...)` + `@Pattern("^[0-9]{10}$")` with `@Pattern("^\\+[0-9]{8,15}$")` and removed the now-unused `@Digits` import, so the persisted E.164 value validates.

**`openapi.yml`** — updated the `telephone` field description and example (`+61412345678`) to document the new normalization; the DTO carried no pattern constraint, so nothing else needed changing.

Verified behavior matches the spec/tests: `0412 345 678` → `+61412345678`, `+64 21 123 456` → `+6421123456`, and `12` → 400. `./mvnw test`: **3 run, 0 failures, BUILD SUCCESS.**
